sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Runaway Toad is a game about exploration and survival. The player must navigate the toad through a procedurally generated swamp, avoiding obstacles and collecting power-ups along the way. The game's controls are simple, with the player using a single finger to tap, hold, and swipe to control the toad's movements. The game's pacing is dynamic, with the player facing relaxed swamp hopping at times and thrilling blimp chases at others. The game's procedurally generated swamps are full of hand-crafted elements, making each playthrough unique and exciting.

The game's core mechanics are centered around the toad's movements and the player's ability to control them. The player must tap to make the toad jump, hold to make it glide, and swipe to change direction. The game's physics engine is realistic, making the toad's movements feel natural and responsive. The player must also collect power-ups, such as bugs and leaves, to earn new abilities and enhance the toad's movements. These power-ups can be used to overcome obstacles, avoid enemies, and reach hidden areas.

The game's procedurally generated swamps are one of its most impressive features. Each playthrough is unique, with the game generating a new swamp with its own obstacles, power-ups, and secrets. The game's algorithm ensures that the swamp is always challenging but never impossible, making each playthrough exciting and rewarding. The game's use of procedural generation also adds to its replay value, as the player can play the game multiple times without experiencing the same swamp twice.

The game's core mechanics are also influenced by the time of day and weather effects. The game's day-night cycle and weather system affect the swamp's difficulty and the toad's movements. For example, the toad may move slower at night or have reduced visibility during a storm. These effects add a new layer of complexity to the game, requiring the player to adapt their strategy to the current conditions. The game's use of time and weather effects also enhances its atmosphere, making the game feel more immersive and realistic.
